NewsArticle.Title: Policy on Transferring of Characters
NewsArticle.Content: Nexon's policy is that you may not transfer characters from one account to another. In order to avoid people selling/exchanging/stealing characters, our system is set up to prohibit such transfers. Nexon will not transfer characters between accounts. Dark Ages servers are fast and stable; running well below maximum load with 0 server lag at peak volume. If you do experience latency, test your connection ( [http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm](http://www.darkages.com/support/trace_route.htm) ).
